topic: Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi: Ganga aur Godavari
subject: Geography
caption:
Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi kaun hai? 🤔 Jawaab hai Ganga, lekin Dakshin Bharat ki Godavari ki kahani bhi kam interesting nahi!

🏞️ Ganga: lambai 2525 km, Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi
🏔️ Srot: Gangotri (Gomukh glacier), sangam: Bay of Bengal
🌊 Godavari: Dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi
🌏 Isiliye Godavari ko kehte hain Dakshin Ganga

Comment karo: Godavari ko Dakshin Ganga kyun kehte hain? A) Ganga mein milti hai B) Dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi nadi hai

first_comment: Answer: B) Godavari Dakshin Bharat (Peninsular India) ki sabse lambi nadi hai, lagbhag 1465 km. Isiliye ise Dakshin Ganga kehte hain.
